children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents where document_kind=final_permit, does the cover page define the governing authorization corpus as the named Parts of that issued permit?
children.semantic_contract: authority_role=ISSUED_GOVERNING_CORPUS; binding text is limited to cover page plus Parts named 'hereof' on the cover page

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents where document_kind in ('part_ii_appendix','part_iv'), are limitations and conditions governed through incorporation by the issued permit's internal cross-references rather than as standalone authorization?
children.semantic_contract: authority_role=INCORPORATED_BY_REFERENCE; adjunct text is binding only as incorporated into the issued permit Parts named on the cover page

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents where document_kind in ('fact_sheet','statement_of_basis','reasonable_potential'), does document text establish an explanatory or calculation-support role that defers enforceable limitations to the issued permit?
children.semantic_contract: authority_role=SUPPORTING_EXPLANATORY; may contain condition-relevant facts but does not independently authorize discharge or set final effluent limitations

children.exact_semantic_question: Does inventory document_kind or filename alone establish binding authority or conflict precedence among package documents?
children.occurrence_partition_rule: all document_inventory.json entries (negative proposition tested against header/text mismatch and absence of kind-ranking text)
children.semantic_contract: document_kind is inventory metadata only; precedence requires document text (issued-permit self-definition, incorporation references, draft/proposed framing)
evidence_grounding: absence of kind-ranking text across documents/

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents where document_kind=minor_modification, does workspace text establish whether the file independently governs or amends the issued permit relative to final_permit?
children.semantic_contract: authority_role unknown; requires explicit incorporation, supersession, or effective-date amendment language linking minor_modification to final_permit
